metadata.title: UMAP: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection for Dimension Reduction
metadata.authors: Leland McInnes, John Healy, James Melville

nodes.name: Category $\boldsymbol{\Delta}$
nodes.statement: The category $\boldsymbol{\Delta}$ has as objects the finite order sets $[n] = \{1, \ldots, n\}$, with morphisms given by (non-strictly) order-preserving maps.
nodes.statement_clean: The simplex category whose objects are finite ordered sets and morphisms are order-preserving maps.
nodes.origin_citation: May, Simplicial Objects in Algebraic Topology

nodes.name: Simplicial set
nodes.statement: A \emph{simplicial set} is a functor from $\boldsymbol{\Delta}^\text{op}$ to $\mathbf{Sets}$; equivalently a contravariant functor from $\boldsymbol{\Delta}$ to $\mathbf{Sets}$.
nodes.statement_clean: A simplicial set is a contravariant functor from the simplex category to Sets.

nodes.name: Fuzzy set (categorical)
nodes.statement: A presheaf $\mathscr{P}$ on $I$ is a functor from $I^\text{op}$ to $\mathbf{Sets}$. A \emph{fuzzy set} is a presheaf on $I$ such that all maps $\mathscr{P}(a\leq b)$ are injections, where $I=(0,1]$.
nodes.statement_clean: A fuzzy set is a presheaf on the unit interval $I=(0,1]$ in which the restriction maps are injective.
nodes.origin_citation: Barr 1986, Fuzzy set theory and topos theory

nodes.name: Category $\mathbf{Fuzz}$ of fuzzy sets
nodes.statement: The category $\mathbf{Fuzz}$ of \emph{fuzzy sets} is the full subcategory of sheaves on $I$ spanned by fuzzy sets.
nodes.statement_clean: The category $\mathbf{Fuzz}$ has fuzzy sets as objects and natural transformations as morphisms.

nodes.name: Category $\mathbf{sFuzz}$ of fuzzy simplicial sets
nodes.statement: The category of \emph{fuzzy simplicial sets} $\mathbf{sFuzz}$ has objects given by functors from $\boldsymbol\Delta^{\text{op}}$ to $\mathbf{Fuzz}$, with morphisms natural transformations.
nodes.statement_clean: Fuzzy simplicial sets are presheaves of fuzzy sets on the simplex category.

nodes.name: Extended-pseudo-metric space
nodes.statement: An \emph{extended-pseudo-metric space} $(X, d)$ is a set $X$ with $d: X\times X\to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}\cup\{\infty\}$ satisfying $d(x,y)\geq 0$ with $x=y \Rightarrow d(x,y)=0$, $d(x,y)=d(y,x)$, and the triangle inequality (or $d=\infty$).
nodes.statement_clean: A symmetric distance with non-negative values that may equal infinity, allowing distinct points at distance zero. Morphisms in $\mathbf{EPMet}$ are non-expansive maps.
nodes.origin_citation: Spivak, Metric realization of fuzzy simplicial sets

nodes.name: Finite fuzzy realization functor $\FinReal$
nodes.statement: $\FinReal:\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}\to\mathbf{FinEPMet}$ sends $\Delta^n_{<a}$ to $(\{x_1,\ldots,x_n\}, d_a)$ with $d_a(x_i,x_j)=-\log(a)$ for $i\neq j$ and $0$ otherwise; extended to general $X$ by colimit.
nodes.statement_clean: Sends standard fuzzy simplices to finite extended-pseudo-metric spaces with uniform off-diagonal distance $-\log(a)$.

nodes.name: Finite fuzzy singular set functor $\FinSing$
nodes.statement: $\FinSing:\mathbf{FinEPMet}\to\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}$ defined by $\FinSing(Y):([n],[0,a))\mapsto \hom_{\mathbf{FinEPMet}}(\FinReal(\Delta^n_{<a}), Y)$.
nodes.statement_clean: The right adjoint of $\FinReal$, sending a finite extended-pseudo-metric space to its fuzzy simplicial set of non-expansive maps from standard fuzzy simplices.

nodes.name: Fuzzy topological representation of a dataset
nodes.statement: For data $X=\{X_1,\ldots,X_N\}\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, the fuzzy topological representation is $\bigcup_{i=1}^N \FinSing((X, d_i))$, where $d_i(X_j,X_k)=d_\mathcal{M}(X_j,X_k)-\rho$ if $i\in\{j,k\}$ and $\infty$ otherwise.
nodes.statement_clean: A single fuzzy simplicial set obtained by applying $\FinSing$ to each per-point local extended-pseudo-metric space and taking the fuzzy union.

nodes.name: Fuzzy set cross entropy
nodes.statement:
$C((A,\mu),(A,
u)) 	riangleq \sum_{a\in A} ig(\mu(a)\log rac{\mu(a)}{
u(a)} + (1-\mu(a))\log rac{1-\mu(a)}{1-
u(a)} ig)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Bernoulli-style cross entropy summed over a common reference set, used to compare two fuzzy sets with membership functions $\mu$ and $\nu$.

nodes.name: Differentiable membership approximation $\Phi$
nodes.statement: $\Phi(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}) = (1 + a(\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\|_2^2)^b)^{-1}$, with $a,b$ chosen by non-linear least squares fit to the piecewise curve $\Psi$ controlled by min-dist.
nodes.statement_clean: A smooth, differentiable approximation of the low-dimensional 1-simplex membership strength used during SGD optimization.

nodes.name: Geodesic-to-ambient distance scaling under locally constant Riemannian metric
nodes.section: 2.1 Uniform distribution of data on a manifold
nodes.statement: Let $(\mathcal{M},g)$ be a Riemannian manifold in ambient $\mathbb{R}^n$ and $p\in\mathcal{M}$. If $g$ is locally constant and diagonal in ambient coordinates near $p$, then in a ball $B$ of $g$-volume $\frac{\pi^{n/2}}{\Gamma(n/2+1)}$ centered at $p$, the geodesic distance from $p$ to $q\in B$ equals $\frac{1}{r} d_{\mathbb{R}^n}(p,q)$.
nodes.statement_clean: On a manifold whose Riemannian metric is locally constant and diagonal, geodesic distance from $p$ inside a unit-volume ball is the ambient distance scaled by $1/r$.
assumptions: $(\mathcal{M},g)$ is a Riemannian manifold in ambient $\mathbb{R}^n$
$g$ is locally constant in an open neighborhood $U$ of $p$ and is a constant diagonal matrix in ambient coordinates
$B\subseteq U$ is a ball centered at $p$ with $g$-volume $\frac{\pi^{n/2}}{\Gamma(n/2+1)}$
$r$ is the radius of $B$ in the ambient $\mathbb{R}^n$
conclusions: For any $q\in B$, the geodesic distance from $p$ to $q$ is $\frac{1}{r} d_{\mathbb{R}^n}(p,q)$

nodes.name: Adjunction $\FinReal \dashv \FinSing$
nodes.statement: The functors $\FinReal:\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}\to\mathbf{FinEPMet}$ and $\FinSing:\mathbf{FinEPMet}\to\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}$ form an adjunction with $\FinReal$ left adjoint and $\FinSing$ right adjoint.
nodes.statement_clean: $\FinReal$ and $\FinSing$ form an adjoint pair between bounded fuzzy simplicial sets and finite extended-pseudo-metric spaces.
assumptions: $\FinSing$ is defined as the hom-set construction $([n],[0,a))\mapsto \hom_{\mathbf{FinEPMet}}(\FinReal(\Delta^n_{<a}), Y)$
conclusions: There is a natural isomorphism $\hom_{\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}}(X, \FinSing(Y)) \cong \hom_{\mathbf{FinEPMet}}(\FinReal(X), Y)$ for $X\in\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}$, $Y\in\mathbf{FinEPMet}$

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 1 (geodesic distance scaling)
nodes.statement: Compute the $g$-volume of $B$ via $\int_B \sqrt{\det g}\, dx^1\wedge\cdots\wedge dx^n$, solve $\det(g)=1/r^{2n}$ to get $g_{ii}=1/r^2$, and substitute into the geodesic-length integral to obtain $\frac{1}{r} d_{\mathbb{R}^n}(p,q)$.

nodes.name: Proof of $\FinReal \dashv \FinSing$ adjunction
nodes.statement: Express $\FinReal$ as the left Kan extension of $F:\boldsymbol{\Delta}\times I\to\mathbf{FinEPMet}$ along the Yoneda embedding, then chain Yoneda isomorphisms to obtain $\hom_{\text{\bf Fin-sFuzz}}(\Delta^n_{<a}, \FinSing(Y)) \cong \hom_{\mathbf{FinEPMet}}(\FinReal(\Delta^n_{<a}), Y)$, and extend to all $X$ by colimit.

nodes.name: UMAP
nodes.statement: Top-level UMAP routine: build the local fuzzy simplicial set at every point, take their fuzzy union, initialize via spectral embedding, and refine by gradient descent on cross-entropy.
input: min-dist (desired separation between close points in embedding)

nodes.name: LocalFuzzySimplicialSet
nodes.statement: Constructs the local fuzzy simplicial set at $x$ from $n$ nearest neighbors, normalizing distances by $\rho$ and $\sigma$ and applying $\exp(-d_{x,y})$ as the membership strength.
output: Local fuzzy simplicial set fs-set with 0-skeleton $X$ and 1-skeleton edges $([x,y], \exp(-d_{x,y}))$ for $y$ in the $n$ nearest neighbors of $x$

nodes.name: SmoothKNNDist
nodes.statement: Binary search for the normalizing scale $\sigma$ such that $\sum_{i=1}^n \exp(-(\text{knn-dists}_i - \rho)/\sigma) = \log_2(n)$.

nodes.name: SpectralEmbedding (initialization)
nodes.statement: Initialize $Y$ as the first $d+1$ eigenvectors of the symmetric normalized graph Laplacian $L = D^{1/2}(D-A)D^{1/2}$ of the 1-skeleton.
output: Initial low-dimensional embedding $Y$ from the leading eigenvectors of $L$

nodes.name: OptimizeEmbedding
nodes.statement: Stochastic gradient descent that samples 1-simplices and applies attractive updates via $\nabla \log\Phi$ and repulsive updates via $\nabla \log(1-\Phi)$ on negative samples, with annealed learning rate $\alpha=1-e/\text{n-epochs}$.
output: Refined low-dimensional embedding $Y$ minimizing fuzzy set cross entropy with respect to the target topology

nodes.name: Nearest-Neighbor-Descent
nodes.statement: Approximate $k$-nearest-neighbor algorithm with empirical complexity $O(N^{1.14})$, used by UMAP for any valid dissimilarity measure.
output: Approximate $k$-nearest neighbors of every point in $X$
nodes.origin_citation: Dong, Charikar, Li 2011, Efficient k-nearest neighbor graph construction

nodes.name: t-SNE
nodes.statement: Probabilistic dimension reduction that calibrates Gaussian conditional probabilities $p_{j|i}$ to a target perplexity, symmetrizes to a joint distribution, and minimizes KL divergence to a Student-$t$ low-dimensional distribution.

nodes.name: LargeVis
nodes.statement: Visualization algorithm that uses approximate nearest neighbors and abandons normalization of $w_{ij}$, optimizing a likelihood-style objective with attractive and $\gamma$-weighted repulsive terms via SGD with negative sampling.

nodes.name: Membership weight on directed $k$-NN edge
nodes.statement: $w((x_i, x_{i_j})) = \exp\!\left(\frac{-\max(0, d(x_i, x_{i_j}) - \rho_i)}{\sigma_i}\right)$.

nodes.name: Probabilistic t-conorm symmetrization
nodes.statement: $B = A + A^\top - A \circ A^\top$, where $\circ$ is the Hadamard product; equivalently $v_{ij} = (v_{j\mid i} + v_{i\mid j}) - v_{j\mid i} v_{i\mid j}$.

nodes.name: UMAP attractive force
nodes.statement: $\frac{-2ab\,\|\mathbf{y_i} - \mathbf{y_j}\|_2^{2(b-1)}}{1 + \|\mathbf{y_i} - \mathbf{y_j}\|_2^2} \, w((x_i, x_j))(\mathbf{y_i}-\mathbf{y_j})$.

nodes.name: UMAP repulsive force
nodes.statement: $\frac{2b}{(\epsilon + \|\mathbf{y_i}-\mathbf{y_j}\|_2^2)(1 + a\|\mathbf{y_i}-\mathbf{y_j}\|_2^{2b})}\,(1 - w((x_i, x_j)))(\mathbf{y_i}-\mathbf{y_j})$, with $\epsilon\approx 0.001$.

nodes.name: UMAP cost function (cross-entropy form)
nodes.statement: $C_{\text{UMAP}} = \sum_{i\neq j} v_{ij}\log\frac{v_{ij}}{w_{ij}} + (1 - v_{ij})\log\frac{1 - v_{ij}}{1 - w_{ij}}$.

nodes.name: Procrustes distance for embedding stability
nodes.statement: $d_P(X,Y) = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^N (x_i - y_i')^2}$, where $Y'$ is the optimal translation, uniform scaling, and rotation of $Y$ minimizing $\sum_i (x_i - y_i')^2$.

nodes.name: Dimension reduction (manifold learning formulation)
nodes.statement: Given high-dimensional data $X=\{X_1,\ldots,X_N\}\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ assumed to lie near a manifold $\mathcal{M}$, find a low-dimensional embedding $Y\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d\ll n$) that preserves the topological structure of $\mathcal{M}$.

nodes.name: UMAP standing axioms
nodes.statement: (A1) There exists a manifold on which the data would be uniformly distributed; (A2) the underlying manifold is locally connected; (A3) preserving the topological structure of this manifold is the primary goal.

nodes.name: Color-cube hyperparameter sweep
nodes.statement: Uniform random samples from a 3-dimensional color cube embedded under varying $n$ and min-dist, illustrating that low $n$ misreads sampling noise as fine-scale manifold structure (the constellation effect).

nodes.name: PenDigits / MNIST / Fashion-MNIST hyperparameter sweep
nodes.statement: UMAP applied to PenDigits, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST under varying $n$ and min-dist, showing that medium $n$ values best resolve cluster structure and that large min-dist compresses clusters together.

nodes.name: Qualitative comparison on COIL-20, MNIST, F-MNIST, GoogleNews
nodes.statement: Side-by-side embeddings by UMAP, t-SNE, LargeVis, Laplacian Eigenmaps and PCA showing that UMAP retains COIL-20 loops, separates MNIST digit classes globally, and discriminates clothing vs. footwear in Fashion-MNIST.

nodes.name: $k$NN classifier accuracy benchmark
nodes.statement: Stratified cross-validation $k$NN accuracy of UMAP/t-SNE/LargeVis/Eigenmaps/PCA embeddings on PenDigits, COIL-20, Shuttle, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST; UMAP matches or beats t-SNE/LargeVis at large $k$, especially on COIL-20 and Shuttle.

nodes.name: Procrustes-based stability on Flow Cytometry
nodes.statement: Per-point Procrustes distance between sub-sample and full-data embeddings on the 1M-sample Flow Cytometry dataset; UMAP at 5\% subsample is already more stable than t-SNE/LargeVis at full data.

nodes.name: Runtime benchmark across datasets
nodes.statement: Wall-clock runtimes of UMAP, FIt-SNE, t-SNE, LargeVis, Eigenmaps, Isomap on PenDigits, COIL20, COIL100, scRNA, Shuttle, MNIST, F-MNIST, Flow, GoogleNews; UMAP is fastest on all but PenDigits.

nodes.name: Scaling with embedding dimension on PenDigits
nodes.statement: Run-time vs. target embedding dimension on PenDigits for UMAP, t-SNE, LargeVis: t-SNE scales worse than exponentially while UMAP and LargeVis are essentially flat (linear with very small slope).

nodes.name: Scaling with ambient dimension on Mouse scRNA
nodes.statement: Run-time vs. ambient dimension after PCA-pre-reduction of the Mouse scRNA dataset; UMAP scales gracefully into tens of thousands of dimensions while t-SNE/FIt-SNE/LargeVis blow up.

nodes.name: Scaling with sample size on GoogleNews subsamples
nodes.section: 5.4.3 Scaling with the Number of Samples
nodes.statement: Run-time vs. dataset size on GoogleNews subsamples; UMAP outperforms Barnes-Hut t-SNE (even multicore) and is comparable to or faster than FIt-SNE/LargeVis.

nodes.name: 30M integers via prime-divisibility binary vectors
nodes.section: 5.4.3 Scaling with the Number of Samples
nodes.statement: UMAP embedding of 30,000,000 integers represented as $\sim$1.8M-dimensional sparse binary divisibility vectors, completed in $\sim$2 weeks on a large-memory SMP and revealing fine-scale structure.

nodes.name: Local connectivity and the role of $\rho_i$
nodes.statement: Setting $\rho_i$ to the nearest non-zero neighbor distance ensures each $x_i$ has at least one outgoing edge of weight 1, making the resulting fuzzy simplicial set locally connected at $x_i$ and substantially improving high-dimensional behavior over t-SNE.

nodes.name: Constellation effect (spurious manifold structure from noise)
nodes.statement: Because UMAP assumes manifold structure, it can fabricate apparent structure from noise in small or noisy datasets, much as the human mind sees constellations in stars; detecting such spurious embeddings is open research.

nodes.name: Higher-order $\ell$-skeleton cost
nodes.statement: The 1-skeleton restriction can be relaxed to $\ell$-skeleta via $C_\ell(X,Y)=\sum_{i=1}^\ell \lambda_i C(X_i, Y_i)$, capturing more topology at the cost of computing higher-dimensional simplices.

nodes.name: Empirical complexity $O(N^{1.14})$
nodes.statement: With Nearest-Neighbor-Descent and edge-sampling SGD, the overall UMAP complexity is empirically $\sim O(N^{1.14})$, dominated by approximate $k$-NN search.

nodes.name: Compute $g$-volume of $B$
nodes.statement: Since $g$ is constant on $U\supseteq B$, the $g$-volume integral $\int_B \sqrt{\det g}\,dx^1\wedge\cdots\wedge dx^n = \sqrt{\det g}\,\frac{\pi^{n/2} r^n}{\Gamma(n/2+1)}$.

nodes.name: Solve for diagonal entries of $g$
nodes.statement: Setting the $g$-volume to $\frac{\pi^{n/2}}{\Gamma(n/2+1)}$ forces $\det(g)=1/r^{2n}$; combined with diagonality yields $g_{ii}=1/r^2$ and $g_{ij}=0$ for $i\neq j$.

nodes.name: Plug into geodesic-length integral
nodes.statement: Substituting $g_{ii}=1/r^2$ into $\inf_{c\in C}\int_a^b \sqrt{g(\dot c, \dot c)}\,dt$ pulls out a factor of $1/r$, yielding $\frac{1}{r}\inf_c \int_a^b \|\dot c\|\,dt = \frac{1}{r}\, d_{\mathbb{R}^n}(p,q)$.

nodes.name: Define $F:\boldsymbol{\Delta}\times I\to\mathbf{FinEPMet}$
nodes.statement: Set $F([n],[0,a)) = (\{x_1,\ldots,x_n\}, d_a)$ with $d_a(x_i,x_j)=-\log(a)$ for $i\neq j$ and $0$ otherwise; this packages the standard fuzzy simplex's metric data.

nodes.name: Express $\FinSing$ via $F$
nodes.statement: Reformulate $\FinSing(Y):([n],[0,a))\mapsto \hom_{\mathbf{FinEPMet}}(F([n],[0,a)), Y)$; functoriality follows from pre-composition with face/degeneracy maps.

nodes.name: Realize $\FinReal$ as left Kan extension of $F$ along Yoneda
nodes.statement: Define $\FinReal(X) = \colim_{y([n],[0,a))\to X} F([n],[0,a))$; by Yoneda, $\FinReal(\Delta^n_{<a}) \cong F([n],[0,a))$.

nodes.name: Chain Yoneda isomorphisms to produce the adjoint iso on standard simplices
nodes.statement: Combine $\hom(\Delta^n_{<a}, \FinSing(Y)) \cong \FinSing(Y)^n_{<a} = \hom(F([n],[0,a)), Y) \cong \hom(\FinReal(\Delta^n_{<a}), Y)$ via two Yoneda applications.

nodes.name: Extend by colimits to all fuzzy simplicial sets
nodes.statement: Every fuzzy simplicial set is a canonical colimit of standard simplices and $\FinReal$ preserves colimits, so the iso on $\Delta^n_{<a}$ extends to a natural iso on arbitrary $X$, giving the adjunction.

nodes.name: Build local fuzzy simplicial set at every $x\in X$
nodes.statement: For each $x\in X$, set fs-set[$x$] $\gets$ \textsc{LocalFuzzySimplicialSet}($X$, $x$, $n$).

nodes.name: Take fuzzy union over points
nodes.statement: top-rep $\gets \bigcup_{x\in X} \text{fs-set}[x]$ using the probabilistic t-conorm.

nodes.name: Spectral initialization
nodes.statement: $Y \gets$ \textsc{SpectralEmbedding}(top-rep, $d$).

nodes.name: Optimize embedding by SGD on cross-entropy
nodes.statement: $Y \gets$ \textsc{OptimizeEmbedding}(top-rep, $Y$, min-dist, n-epochs).

nodes.name: Return $Y$
nodes.statement: Return the optimized low-dimensional embedding $Y$.

nodes.name: Approximate $n$-NN search
nodes.statement: (knn, knn-dists) $\gets$ \textsc{ApproxNearestNeighbors}($X$, $x$, $n$).

nodes.name: Set $\rho$ and $\sigma$
nodes.statement: $\rho \gets$ knn-dists[1]; $\sigma \gets$ \textsc{SmoothKNNDist}(knn-dists, $n$, $\rho$).

nodes.name: Initialize fs-set 0/1 skeleta
nodes.statement: fs-set$_0 \gets X$; fs-set$_1 \gets \{([x,y], 0)\mid y\in X\}$.

nodes.name: Add weighted 1-simplices for each neighbor
nodes.statement: For each $y\in$ knn: $d_{x,y}\gets \max\{0, \text{dist}(x,y)-\rho\}/\sigma$; fs-set$_1\gets \text{fs-set}_1 \cup ([x,y], \exp(-d_{x,y}))$.

nodes.name: Return fs-set
nodes.statement: Return the local fuzzy simplicial set fs-set.

nodes.name: Binary search for $\sigma$
nodes.statement: Binary search for $\sigma$ such that $\sum_{i=1}^n \exp(-(\text{knn-dists}_i - \rho)/\sigma) = \log_2(n)$.

nodes.name: Return $\sigma$
nodes.statement: Return the calibrated normalizing factor $\sigma$.

nodes.name: Form weighted adjacency $A$
nodes.statement: $A \gets$ 1-skeleton of top-rep expressed as a weighted adjacency matrix.

nodes.name: Build symmetric normalized Laplacian
nodes.statement: $D \gets$ degree matrix of $A$; $L \gets D^{1/2}(D - A) D^{1/2}$.

nodes.name: Take leading eigenvectors as embedding
nodes.statement: evec $\gets$ Eigenvectors of $L$ (sorted); $Y \gets$ evec[1..$d+1$]; return $Y$.

nodes.name: Initialize $\alpha$ and fit $\Phi$
nodes.statement: $\alpha \gets 1.0$; fit $\Phi$ from $\Psi$ defined by min-dist via non-linear least squares.

nodes.name: Epoch loop with edge sampling and attractive update
nodes.statement: For $e=1,\ldots,$ n-epochs and each $([a,b], p)\in\text{top-rep}_1$, with probability $p$ apply attractive update $y_a\gets y_a + \alpha\,\nabla\log\Phi(y_a, y_b)$.

nodes.name: Negative-sampling repulsive update
nodes.statement: Inside each accepted edge update, draw n-neg-samples random $c$ from $Y$ and apply $y_a \gets y_a + \alpha\,\nabla\log(1-\Phi)(y_a, y_c)$.

nodes.name: Anneal learning rate per epoch
nodes.statement: After each epoch update $\alpha \gets 1.0 - e/\text{n-epochs}$.

nodes.name: Return refined $Y$
nodes.statement: Return the optimized low-dimensional embedding $Y$.
